g.text: A visible query is fully correct when the selected box matches the annotation and every requested detail is correct.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #435966

g.text: An absent query is correct when the detector returns no box. Cell shading is scaled within each actual class.
